class.name: OcgGeom2dEllipse
class.brief_description: Describes an ellipse in the plane (2D space). An ellipse is defined by its major and minor radii and, as with any conic curve, is positioned in the plane with a coordinate system (gp_Ax22d object) where: - the origin is the center of the ellipse, - the "X Direction" defines the major axis, and - the "Y Direction" defines the minor axis. This coordinate system is the local coordinate system of the ellipse. The orientation (direct or indirect) of the local coordinate system gives an explicit orientation to the ellipse, determining the direction in which the parameter increases along the ellipse. The Geom2d_Ellipse ellipse is parameterized by an angle: P(U) = O + MajorRad*std::cos(U)*XDir + MinorRad*Sin(U)*YDir where: - P is the point of parameter U, - O, XDir and YDir are respectively the origin, "X Direction" and "Y Direction" of its local coordinate system, - MajorRad and MinorRad are the major and minor radii of the ellipse. The "X Axis" of the local coordinate system therefore defines the origin of the parameter of the ellipse. An ellipse is a closed and periodic curve. The period is 2.*Pi and the parameter range is [ 0,2.*Pi [. See Also GCE2d_MakeEllipse which provides functions for more complex ellipse constructions gp_Ax22d gp_Elips2d for an equivalent, non-parameterized data structure

method.name: from_1
method.description: Creates an ellipse by conversion of the gp_Elips2d ellipse E.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates an ellipse defined by its major and minor radii, MajorRadius and MinorRadius, where the coordinate system Axis locates the ellipse and defines its orientation in the plane such that: - the center of the ellipse is the origin of Axis, - the "X Direction" of Axis defines the major axis of the ellipse, - the "Y Direction" of Axis defines the minor axis of the ellipse, - the orientation of Axis (direct or indirect) gives the orientation of the ellipse. Warnings : It is not forbidden to create an ellipse with MajorRadius = MinorRadius. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if: - MajorRadius is less than MinorRadius, or - MinorRadius is less than 0.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates an ellipse defined by its major and minor radii, MajorRadius and MinorRadius, and positioned in the plane by its major axis MajorAxis; the center of the ellipse is the origin of MajorAxis and the unit vector of MajorAxis is the "X Direction" of the local coordinate system of the ellipse; this coordinate system is direct if Sense is true (default value) or indirect if Sense is false. Warnings : It is not forbidden to create an ellipse with MajorRadius = MinorRadius. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if: - MajorRadius is less than MinorRadius, or - MinorRadius is less than 0.

method.name: SetElips2d
method.description: Converts the gp_Elips2d ellipse E into this ellipse.

method.name: SetMajorRadius
method.description: Assigns a value to the major radius of this ellipse. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if: - the major radius of this ellipse becomes less than the minor radius, or - MinorRadius is less than 0.

method.name: SetMinorRadius
method.description: Assigns a value to the minor radius of this ellipse. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if: - the major radius of this ellipse becomes less than the minor radius, or - MinorRadius is less than 0.

method.name: Elips2d
method.description: Converts this ellipse into a gp_Elips2d ellipse.

method.name: ReversedParameter
method.description: Computes the parameter on the reversed ellipse for the point of parameter U on this ellipse. For an ellipse, the returned value is: 2.*Pi - U.

method.name: Directrix1
method.description: Computes the directrices of this ellipse. This directrix is the line normal to the XAxis of the ellipse in the local plane (Z = 0) at a distance d = MajorRadius / e from the center of the ellipse, where e is the eccentricity of the ellipse. This line is parallel to the "YAxis". The intersection point between directrix1 and the "XAxis" is the "Location" point of the directrix1. This point is on the positive side of the "XAxis". Raises ConstructionError if Eccentricity = 0.0. (The ellipse degenerates into a circle)

method.name: Directrix2
method.description: This line is obtained by the symmetrical transformation of "Directrix1" with respect to the "YAxis" of the ellipse. Raises ConstructionError if Eccentricity = 0.0. (The ellipse degenerates into a circle).

method.name: Eccentricity
method.description: Returns the eccentricity of the ellipse between 0.0 and 1.0 If f is the distance between the center of the ellipse and the Focus1 then the eccentricity e = f / MajorRadius. Returns 0 if MajorRadius = 0

method.name: Focal
method.description: Computes the focal distance. The focal distance is the distance between the center and a focus of the ellipse.

method.name: Focus1
method.description: Returns the first focus of the ellipse. This focus is on the positive side of the "XAxis" of the ellipse.

method.name: Focus2
method.description: Returns the second focus of the ellipse. This focus is on the negative side of the "XAxis" of the ellipse.

method.name: MajorRadius
method.description: Returns the major radius of this ellipse.

method.name: MinorRadius
method.description: Returns the minor radius of this ellipse.

method.name: Parameter
method.description: Computes the parameter of this ellipse. This value is given by the formula p = (1 - e * e) * MajorRadius where e is the eccentricity of the ellipse. Returns 0 if MajorRadius = 0

method.name: FirstParameter
method.description: Returns the value of the first parameter of this ellipse. This is 0.0, which gives the start point of this ellipse. The start point and end point of an ellipse are coincident.

method.name: LastParameter
method.description: Returns the value of the last parameter of this ellipse. This is 2.*Pi, which gives the end point of this ellipse. The start point and end point of an ellipse are coincident.

method.name: IsClosed
method.description: return True.

method.name: IsPeriodic
method.description: return True.

method.name: EvalD0
method.description: Returns in P the point of parameter U. P = C + MajorRadius * Cos (U) * XDir + MinorRadius * Sin (U) * YDir where C is the center of the ellipse , XDir the direction of the "XAxis" and "YDir" the "YAxis" of the ellipse.

method.name: EvalDN
method.description: For the point of parameter U of this ellipse, computes the vector corresponding to the Nth derivative. Exceptions Standard_RangeError if N is less than 1.

method.name: Transform
method.description: Applies the transformation T to this ellipse.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
